_comment: PHASE 6.98 — TASK 4: Satis private package repository configuration (FOUNDATION ONLY)
_note: This file defines the ARCHITECTURE for production module distribution via a private Satis server. Do NOT deploy yet. Replace placeholder URLs with real infrastructure URLs before deploying.
name: saas-platform/private
description: Private Satis repository for SaaS Platform canonical modules

_deployment_notes.step_1: Replace all example.com URLs with real infrastructure domains
_deployment_notes.step_2: Configure VCS authentication (SSH keys or tokens) in Satis server
_deployment_notes.step_3: Run: php satis.phar build satis.json public/ to generate repository
_deployment_notes.step_4: Serve the public/ directory from a private web server (nginx/Apache)
_deployment_notes.step_5: Add Satis repository to customer-site composer.json (see docs/architecture/distributed-module-delivery.md)
_deployment_notes.step_6: Configure HTTP Basic Auth or token-based access control on the web server
_deployment_notes.local_dev: Path repositories in composer.json override Satis — local development is unaffected
